title: FlowBackTest consent-aware event envelope
description: Contract for the implemented browser-memory synthetic debug log. No live analytics destination, real lead, signup verification, interview booking or server-side dedupe is connected. See QA.md and tests/telemetry.mjs for verified boundaries.

event_id.description: Unique event identifier generated once per accepted event.

namespace.description: Current build may emit only demo.synthetic. production.leads is reserved for an explicitly connected later integration.

timestamp.description: UTC ISO 8601 occurrence time. Sample process timestamps belong in fixtures, not this field.

session_id.description: Ephemeral random browser-memory session identifier; no cross-session identity or entered email.

route.description: Canonical pathname only. Do not log URL query strings containing free text or personal data.

analytics.description: Log an analytics event only after an explicit opt-in. A declined preference is not a tracked event.

dedupe_key.description: Session-scoped key based on namespace, event name, canonical route and intentional action instance. A rerender or duplicate listener must not create a second event.

utm.description: Allowlisted campaign fields only. Sanitize values and exclude personal data. Missing values stay null/absent; do not invent campaign attribution. Never collect the entire referring URL.

entry_point.description: Controlled UI identifier such as hero_demo_cta; no user-entered text.

completion_definition.description: Controlled identifier for the actually reached demo milestone; never buyer qualification.

evidence_ref.description: Production-only opaque reference to actual verification/booking evidence. Never include contact data or booking details.

x-current-build-policy.storage: Browser memory only; inspected implementation. No local/session storage or cookies.
x-current-build-policy.transport: None. User-triggered download of the synthetic debug log only.
x-current-build-policy.dedupe: Implemented client session dedupe. Server-side dedupe remains required before real conversion tracking.
x-current-build-policy.revocation: Stop logging immediately when analytics consent is revoked; clear current in-memory event log and identifiers through the visible demo clear/reset control.
x-current-build-policy.form_boundary: Form success is a local draft; no request delivered, no account verified and no interview booked.
quality_checks_verified: Duplicate render/listener does not duplicate an event
Synthetic and real namespaces never mixed
No personal form values in debug events
No fixture payload in outbound request
Local success does not fire verified_signup or interview_booked

landing_view.trigger: Canonical public page becomes readable after navigation with analytics opt-in
landing_view.dedupe: Once per intentional route-view instance; no duplicate on rerender

demo_complete.trigger: Visitor reaches the defined mock scenario/backtest completion state
demo_complete.current_status: Demo only; implemented; no qualified lead or customer validation implication

form_start.trigger: First user interaction with a study/contact demo form

form_submit.trigger: Valid fields and explicit required privacy consent produce local draft success
form_submit.dedupe: Once per intentional accepted submit instance; block duplicate handler events
form_submit.current_status: Demo only; implemented; submission_state must be local_draft

verified_signup.trigger: Future server confirms a genuine signup/required verification
verified_signup.dedupe: Server-side by verification evidence and event ID
verified_signup.current_status: Disabled in this demo; no real verification connected

interview_booked.trigger: Future booking service confirms an actual appointment
interview_booked.dedupe: Server-side by booking evidence and event ID
interview_booked.current_status: Disabled in this demo; no calendar/booking service connected
